envelope.description: Add design-review admission and resource-guard contracts

body.title: Add design-review admission and resource-guard contracts
body.summary: Consume the shared resource types and extend design-review contracts/checkpoint codecs/discriminating readers with the approved admission variant. Preserve current qualified attempt/chunk histories, source-subject identities and explicit recovery rules; do not switch production routing yet.
acceptanceChecks: Design admission preserves immutable input/action identity while subject/history qualification remains unverified; planning/chunk results are absent until actually established.
Historical design checkpoints remain readable without rewriting accepted feedback; unknown formats and ambiguous attempted conversions refuse explicitly.
Design resourceGuard updates use the single serialized checkpoint writer alongside progress/results, preventing lost open intents or premature lease closure.
Existing artifact-change invalidation, explicit recovery and approval-evidence distinctions remain intact; unverified admission cannot approve an artifact.

tests.name: src/workflow/review/design-review/__tests__/admission-checkpoint.test.ts: historical design attempts and unverified admission retain separate semantics
src/workflow/review/design-review/__tests__/checkpoint-progress.test.ts: serialized resource and progress updates cannot lose open intents
